contract.role: research/forecast lane only; nothing here is a rating prior, a solve prior, or a VPM input
contract.objective: next-game exposure-weighted squared error (per 100 possessions for rates, per attempt for percentages); rest-of-season aggregates are secondary
contract.pre_tip_rule: every feature must be constructible before tip from information available live (completed-game rosters, schedule, prior-game residuals)
contract.observations: measured observations only; *_filled values, inferred zeros and estimates are never observations; an unmeasured game is NaN, never zero

holdout.2026: export-only or spent limited evidence; never next-game scored by v4 or any lab recipe; v1 was scored once against naive baselines on 2026-08-27 and the v3 forward confirmation ran once

contract.providers: EPM, DARKO, DPM and eWINS are never features, targets or tuning inputs, and provider values are never copied into published or committed artifacts
contract.artifacts: everything under nba_pipeline/results/estimated_skills/ is generated and stays out of git; this registry and its builder are the checked-in source

status_vocabulary.live: a dated current per-player estimate is exported and appears on the values table; the model is frozen and 2026 is export-only
status_vocabulary.development: a model is selected on development seasons but has no current-state export, so the table still shows the incumbent
status_vocabulary.increment: an increment that passed development and frozen stress but is not exported to any table
status_vocabulary.measurement: a measurement layer only (retrospective baseline); not a forecast
status_vocabulary.imputation: a postgame repair layer that prepares inputs; its filled values are never observations
status_vocabulary.diagnostic: descriptive or comparison output only; nothing is estimated for the next game
status_vocabulary.failed: tested against a pre-declared gate and rejected; nothing on any table changed

pbp_panel.table_model: v1 scalar Kalman random walk (build 2026-08-26, receipts eval_report.json and hyperparams.json)
pbp_panel.dev_selected_model: v4: OU state with population attractor + debut/age/early-season corrections + pre-tip context (build_nba_estimated_skills_v4.py; v4_nextgame.json)

D.description: playoff term + minutes trend, multiplicative context, usage-form cross-skill feature, team-change jump

F.description: same as D with the full 16-skill cross-skill form block

G.description: D without the minutes trend (playoff term only)

pbp_panel.builder_note: v4 has no current-state export and there is no v5 builder; assemble() in research_skills_nextgame_lab.py is the specification of the recipe

export.value_source: families[<family>].pbp_value_pattern formatted with the skill id, times display_scale

stats.label: Rim FG%
stats.notes: On the table as v1. The only percentage the lab moves: the playoff term is worth about +0.05% on dev. The rim blocked-shot feature (lane 10) failed and changed nothing.
stats.next_step: Promote with the rest of the panel when a v5 builder exists; no stat-specific work pending.

stats.label: Mid-range FG%
stats.notes: On the table as v1. No lab recipe: every extra feature is null for mid-range percentage, so v4 is the ceiling under the current feature set.
stats.next_step: None beyond the panel-wide v5 build.

stats.label: 3P%
stats.notes: On the table as v1 blended with the owner-authorized volume prior (low-volume shooters are pulled toward the population curve for their attempt rate). The plain v1 value is kept beside it. No lab recipe helps 3P%; the untested idea is a volume-dependent attractor inside the filter.
stats.next_step: Test a volume-dependent attractor as a lab option; keep the volume prior on the table until then.

stats.label: FT%
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe D is worth about +0.02% on dev (mostly the team-change jump); effectively at the ceiling.
stats.next_step: None beyond the panel-wide v5 build.

stats.label: Rim FGA /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe F (all-skill form + jump) adds +0.29% on dev over re-tuned v4. Same-day 2026 comparison vs EPM was inconclusive; next appearance within 7 days favoured v1 by +1.5% (lane 15, spent).
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe F; do not rerun the 2026 EPM comparison until the owner pre-registers one pass.

stats.label: Mid FGA /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. The biggest lab gainer: v4 context is worth +1.64% over OU and recipe F a further +0.71% on dev. The gap between the table (v1) and the best known model is largest here.
stats.next_step: First stat to promote once a v5 builder exists.

stats.label: 3PA /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. v4 context +1.06% over OU; recipe F +0.30% more on dev. The minutes trend is worth keeping here (+0.03%).
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe F.

stats.label: FTA /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe F +0.30% on dev; usage form and minutes trend both matter for free-throw rate. Personal fouls drawn (lane 20) is the CDN-measured companion stat.
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe F; later test PFD as a cross-family form feature.

stats.label: PTS /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe F +0.50% on dev, 6/6 seasons; the all-skill form block is worth +0.17% of that.
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe F.

stats.label: AST /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe D +0.44% on dev; the playoff term carries most of it and the full form block does not help assists. Potential assists (lane 19) is the tracking companion.
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe D.

stats.label: TOV /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe F +0.32% on dev; the all-skill form block alone is +0.23%.
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe F.

stats.label: OREB /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe F +0.11% on dev but only 4/6 seasons; D, F and G are within each other's intervals, so one rebound recipe (G) is acceptable.
stats.next_step: Build v5; use the rebound recipe.

stats.label: Usage %
stats.notes: On the table as v1. v4 adds pre-tip teammate absence (+0.30 pp fair increment; the withdrawn realised-roster version was inflated) and recipe F a further +0.27% on dev. Team-change jump is worth +0.12% here.
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe F.

stats.label: DREB /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe G +0.06% on dev; absence features are null for rebounds. Contested DREB (lane 19) is the tracking companion.
stats.next_step: Build v5 with the rebound recipe.

stats.label: STL /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe D +0.04% on dev. The bigger known gain is outside the panel: pregame deflections add +0.41% on stress (lane 5) and are not exported.
stats.next_step: In v5, feed deflections into steals as a context feature inside the filter instead of the post-hoc ridge.

stats.label: BLK /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe D +0.36% on dev; the all-skill form block hurts blocks (-0.09%), so usage form only. Rim points saved (lane 9) is not yet clearly better than blocks alone.
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe D; keep the blocks-vs-rim-saved pair reported on every rim rerun.

stats.label: PF committed /100
stats.notes: On the table as v1. Recipe F +0.29% on dev; the playoff term is worth +0.20%. Fouls committed is the repo-PBP side; fouls drawn (lane 20) is the CDN side.
stats.next_step: Build v5 with recipe F.

stats.label: Deflections /100 def
stats.table_model: next_ou (plain OU, no corrections, no context)
stats.notes: Live and dated. OU beat the re-tuned random walk on frozen stress and beats every naive baseline by 5-11%. The longer-horizon comparator (lane 3) and the playoff offset (lane 4) are preserved but not used. Stress is spent, so any lab work must declare 2020-2025 as development and lean on 2027.
stats.next_step: Direct port of the lab winners (multiplicative opponent/own-team residuals, playoff term, jump, cross-skill form) with 2020-2025 declared as development.

stats.label: Potential assists /100 off
stats.notes: Live and dated. Held on stress 3/3 seasons vs the random walk. Uses only measured game logs; the backfill's repaired values (lane 6) are never observations.
stats.next_step: Playoff term first (top-quartile PA drops -1.68 in the playoffs per lane 7), then the rest of the lab winners, with 2020-2025 declared as development.

stats.label: Drives /100 off
stats.notes: Live and dated. Second-largest OU gain in the tracking family; held on stress 3/3.
stats.next_step: Same lab port as potential assists.

stats.label: Possession minutes /100 off
stats.notes: Live and dated. Largest OU gain in the family (+2.5% on stress vs the random walk) because on-ball time is the most persistent tracking stat.
stats.next_step: Same lab port; this is the stat most likely to benefit from the usage-form feature.

stats.label: Contested shots /100 def
stats.table_model: next_ou (plain OU; frozen despite a stress reversal)
stats.notes: Live and dated, with a caveat: OU won on dev but lost to the random walk on stress (about -0.1%, 0/3 seasons). It was frozen rather than switched, so treat OU and the random walk as equivalent here. Still beats the naive baselines.
stats.next_step: First tracking stat to re-examine in a lab (opponent shot-volume context is the obvious pre-tip feature).

stats.label: Defended FGA /100 def
stats.notes: Live and dated. Held on stress 3/3. DFGA nulls mix omitted zeros with outages; only measured games are observations (inferred zeros from lane 6 are excluded).
stats.next_step: Same lab port as the other tracking stats.

stats.label: Contested DREB /100 def
stats.notes: Live and dated. Smallest positive OU gain in the family but held 3/3 on stress.
stats.next_step: Same lab port; the playoff decline for top-quartile contested rebounders (-0.44 per lane 7) makes the playoff term the first candidate.

stats.label: Offensive fouls drawn /100 def
stats.numerator: CDN offensive fouls drawn (charges + non-charge screens/push-offs; technicals excluded)
stats.table_model: next_ou (plain OU; near-equivalent to the random walk)
stats.notes: Live and dated. This is the superset: charges plus illegal screens and push-offs (the feed cannot split screens from push-offs). The dev gate barely cleared, so OU and the random walk are near-equivalent; both beat the naive baselines by 7-8%. Measured from the NBA live CDN feed, 2019-20 onward only.
stats.next_step: Multiplicative opponent term (the fouling team's tendency is known before tip), then the playoff term; 2021-2025 declared as development.

stats.label: Charges drawn /100 def
stats.table_model: next_ou (plain OU; near-equivalent to the random walk)
stats.notes: Live and dated. The charge-descriptor subset of offensive fouls drawn; rare (about 0.13 per 100 in the warm-up season), so estimates are heavily shrunk. OU and the random walk are near-equivalent.
stats.next_step: Same lab port as offensive fouls drawn.

stats.label: Personal fouls drawn /100 off
stats.notes: Live and dated. The clearest fouls-drawn result: OU beat the random walk on dev and held 3/3 on stress. Reconciles with box PFD on every measured game.
stats.next_step: Same lab port; also a candidate cross-family feature for the FTA-rate filter.

stats.label: Rim points saved /100 def
stats.numerator: 2*(rim FGA*league-relative normal% - rim FGM) on <6 ft contests
stats.table_model: exponential decay (730-day half-life, K=100 prior attempts), not the OU engine
stats.notes: Live and dated, but the weakest live lane: one development season (2023, because pre-2023 source fields were season totals), a different estimator from every other lane, and it is not yet clearly better than blocks alone (interval crosses zero). Blocks plus rim saved does beat blocks alone. Saved points combine a contest rate and a finishing suppression, exported beside the headline.
stats.next_step: Re-express contest rate and suppression as OU states on the shared engine before any context work; report the blocks-only pair on every rerun.

lanes.name: PBP Kalman panel (17 skills)
lanes.state: Table shows v1 (Aug 26, 2026 build). v4 is dev-selected (17/17 skills, 101/102 seasons vs OU, median +0.56%) but has no current-state export. Lab round 3 fixes a per-skill recipe worth a further median +0.29% (15/17 CI above zero); there is no v5 builder. 2026 is partially exposed (v1 naive-baseline holdout scored once; v3 forward confirmation scored once) and has never been next-game scored by v4 or a recipe.

lanes.name: Next-game deflections OU
lanes.state: Live; stress spent.

lanes.name: Longer-horizon estimated deflections
lanes.state: Rest-of-season objective, rejected by the owner in favour of next-game error. Kept only as the comparator for lane 2 (its forward-horizon OU beats the random walk by 1.66% on stress). Not on any table.

lanes.name: Deflections playoff offset
lanes.state: An additive prior-season playoff offset (-0.18 to -0.39 per 100) did not clear development and went slightly negative on stress. Lane 2 unchanged. The lab's multiplicative playoff term is a different form and is still a candidate.

lanes.name: Deflections-to-steals increment
lanes.state: Pregame deflections add a real increment to next-game steals (dev and stress both positive, coefficient 0.23-0.28 extra steals per deflection). Not exported to any table. The same-day 2026 EPM comparison was inconclusive and is spent.

lanes.name: Tracking game-log backfill
lanes.state: Postgame repair of potential assists and DFGA (355,995 audited rows). Preparation only: lanes 19 and 20 read measured values and never the *_filled columns.

lanes.name: Tracking playoff quartiles
lanes.state: Descriptive RS-to-playoff rate changes by quartile (top-quartile potential assists -1.68, deflections -0.48 per 100). Regression to the mean is not removed; the playoff term must be tested inside the filters instead.

lanes.name: Rim contest savings and matchup burden
lanes.state: Measurement layer for lane 9. The provider season-normal baseline is retrospective, so this is not a forecast and is not on the values table; 476 ambiguous PBP rows are excluded and the 2026 matchup source is incomplete.

lanes.name: Rolling predictive rim points saved
lanes.state: Live; weakest live lane (see the stat row).

lanes.name: Rim blocked-shot prior
lanes.state: Prior BLKA/FGA as an extra rim FG% feature fails development and stress. Nothing changed.

lanes.name: Three-point volume prior
lanes.state: Owner-authorized on the table for 3P% only (strength 0.5). Small overall gain, large for low-volume shooters. Exported through 2026 observations without scoring 2026.

lanes.name: Shooting fusion
lanes.state: Cross-skill ridge/boosted 3P% corrections win conditional log loss but fail the joint makes gate; the selected volume+FT prior has stress gains of a few hundredths of a percent and no confirmed makes increment over the volume prior alone. Not on the table.

lanes.name: Physical features
lanes.state: Height/wingspan adapter (509 of 582 current players covered, undated source). Candidate predictors only; the fusion test with physical features failed the joint gate.

lanes.name: Team-game and league seasonality
lanes.state: The game-number cubic selects zero on development. Descriptive calendar drift exists but is not a validated context term. Low priority.

lanes.name: Attempt rates vs EPM (2026)
lanes.state: v1 rim/mid/three attempt rates against 12 cached EPM dates on 2026: same-day inconclusive, next appearance within 7 days rim +1.5%. Spent 2026 evidence for v1, not v4. Provider rows stay private.

lanes.name: EPM E-Skills benchmark (2026)
lanes.state: Aggregate-only correlation and level-adjusted MSE receipts for v1 vs the same 12 EPM snapshots. Spent 2026 evidence; provider values never copied.

lanes.name: Current skill comparison table
lanes.state: The local reader table the values export is built from: v1 for every PBP skill except 3P% (volume prior) plus next-game deflections. Its EPM/DARKO columns are private and local only; this registry copies none of them.

lanes.name: 2026 forward confirmation (v3)
lanes.state: One-shot rest-of-season confirmation of v1 vs v3 (15/17, median +4.81%) on a rejected objective. This is why 2026 counts as partially exposed for lane 1; v3 must not be selected.

lanes.name: Next-game tracking filters (six stats)
lanes.state: Live; stress spent; contested shots reversed on stress but stays frozen.

lanes.name: Next-game fouls-drawn filters (three stats)
lanes.state: Live; stress spent; 8,543 of 8,879 games measured from the CDN ledger.
